candidates.title: I'm looking for U.S. resident who can work with me and get extra money weekly or monthly
candidates.description:
We're building AI agency company so we need U.S. resident who can provide AI platform accounts and get salary monthly.
Anyone can work with us if he is honest and fast learner. No need any special skillset.
Until there is stable income, My company can pay as fixed amount and Once income is there then we can share the profit as commission since you're co-founder.
If he or she has own laptop or PC then that's perfect. this is optional, we can provide laptop also
Age should be 26 ~ 40
